items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: when you quit Jack Carey, who came in on trombone with your band? ... E.D. Morris.

ctx.x: Well now, when you quit Jack Carey, who came in on trombone with your band?
E.D. Morris. Right on. I'm right in. I see. I said, George Boyd went and got him right away.
And that would be around the time you were playing with Celestan then, huh?
